prompt: Build an 8-qubit circuit that implements: (1) the same reversible Boolean-function circuit as the standard reversible_boolean4_8q task — qubits 0-3 are inputs a, b, c, d; qubits 4-7 start at |0> and are computed as qubit 4 = a XOR b XOR c XOR d (parity), qubit 5 = a AND b AND c AND d, qubit 6 = a AND b, qubit 7 = c AND d, using CNOT, Toffoli (CCX), and a 4-controlled-X (MCX) gate, with each output computed using ONLY qubits 0-3 as controls (no output may control another) — followed by (2) the 8-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (standard textbook definition: Hadamard and controlled-phase gates, followed by the final SWAP-reversal layer) applied to all 8 qubits. This must work as a general-purpose block for ARBITRARY input on qubits 0-3, not just a fixed input. No measurement.
